description.value: Noble Ridge Vineyards is a family-founded estate winery perched on a ridge above Okanagan Falls in the South Okanagan wine country, offering stunning vineyard views and curated tastings of its award-winning sparkling, white, rosé, and red wines. The tasting room features a five-wine flight experience and a retail wine shop, with tasting fees donated to community causes. The property also hosts seasonal food-and-wine pairing events and offers on-site accommodations, making it a scenic destination for cyclists exploring the South Okanagan wine route.

address.value: 2320 Oliver Ranch Road, Okanagan Falls, BC V0H 1R2
